# Photoshop MCP — Digital Painting Edition

> Independently maintained Windows-first Photoshop MCP system — 130 tools including painting, VisualMicroPlan execution, color sampling, landmarks/guides, previews, embedded Guard orchestration and 0 recipes. Not affiliated with Adobe.

**Project:** https://github.com/lavalava45/photoshop-mcp-digital-painting
**Historical provenance:** `NOTICE`

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lavalava45/photoshop-mcp-digital-painting.git
cd photoshop-mcp-digital-painting
npm install
npm run build:server
node dist/index.js
```

**Prerequisites:** Adobe Photoshop on Windows 10/11, Node.js 18+. Photoshop must be running. The maintained semantic route uses the UXP companion in `uxp-plugin/`.

**Chat On Steroids:** ordinary Photoshop work uses the live-accepted
`Chat_On_Steroids_Plugins → dist/cos-plugin.js → embedded Guard → Photoshop` route.
`dist/cos-plugin.js` enables required mode: direct reads remain available, while raw
mutations fail closed with `guard_required` and must run through
`photoshop_guard_cycle_auto`. The retired external Core/controller/daemon provider chain is removed.

## Agent workflow

```
get_capabilities → get_state → semantic tool chain → get_preview to verify
```

Compose supported semantic `photoshop_*` tools directly. Use the five `ps.*` guide prompts for reusable multi-step planning. On failure, read structured error envelopes (`code`, `suggested_next_tool`) and call `get_state` before retrying.

## MCP client configuration

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "photoshop": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/absolute/path/to/photoshop-mcp-digital-painting/dist/index.js"],
      "env": { "LOG_LEVEL": "1" }
    }
  }
}
```

## Tool surface

- **130 tools** — semantic `photoshop_*` surface; 14 are the embedded `photoshop_guard_*` façade
- **5 MCP prompts** — including `ps.digital_painting_control`
- **Native Sky Replacement** — optional sky replacement using Photoshop's built-in feature
- **State** — `photoshop_get_state`, `photoshop_get_preview`, `photoshop_get_capabilities`
